sample_unit: exam questions (344 from 107th JNEP, 345 from 108th JNEP)

links.outcome: GPT-4 accuracy on calculation questions versus other question types in pharmacist exam
links.effect: Overall accuracy was 64.5% (222/344) and 62.9% (217/345); accuracy tended to be lower for physics, chemistry, and calculation questions.
links.quote: The accuracy rates tended to be lower for physics, chemistry, and calculation questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark performance of GPT-4 on the Japanese National Examination for Pharmacists without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
